title: The record's classification drives the transport response's retry hint
asA: caller of an application endpoint that failed
iWant: the transport response to reflect whether the failure is retryable
soThat: my retry policy honours the origin's judgement instead of guessing from the status code alone

acceptanceCriteria.description: A record with category transient produces a wire response the transport ADR maps to a retryable envelope (HTTP: a 5xx or a 429 with a Retry-After hint when the origin supplied one on the record); a record with category permanent produces a non-retryable envelope with no Retry-After (HTTP: a 4xx); a record with category unknown is treated as permanent by the wire but logged at error level.
acceptanceCriteria.given: three failing handler paths that construct records with category transient, permanent and unknown respectively
acceptanceCriteria.then: the transport response bodies and headers reflect the per-class contract above

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a record with category `permanent`, the transport response the mapper writes carries no Retry-After header and no retry-hint field on the envelope, regardless of whether the origin supplied one; the HTTP status is a non-retryable class (4xx that is not 408 or 429) per ADR-1703. The check drives the mapper with fixture records at each category and inspects the wire response.
acceptanceCriteria.when: the transport response mapper writes the wire response
acceptanceCriteria.then: no Retry-After header and no retry-hint field appear on the envelope; the HTTP status is a non-retryable class per ADR-1703

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a record with category `unknown`, the transport response is logged at error level and mapped to a non-retryable wire response identical in classification to `permanent`; no Retry-After hint is emitted even if the origin supplied one on the record (unknown is not a permission to retry). The check inspects the mapped response and the emitted log line's level attribute.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a record with category `unknown` and an origin-supplied Retry-After hint
acceptanceCriteria.when: the mapper writes the wire response
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is non-retryable (no Retry-After), the log line for the record is level `error`, and the wire status matches the `permanent` mapping per ADR-1703

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a project that elicited additional categories via the `classification-additions` elicit (for example `rate-limited`, `dependency-degraded`), when a record carries one of those categories, the mapper reads the applied per-class contract (elicited additions apply alongside the ADR-1702 defaults) and writes the retry hint the elicited class contract specifies; an unknown category token that the project never elicited is refused at record construction per REQ-002. Applying agent sets: the elicited additional category tokens and the per-class retry contract.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project with elicited additional categories and a record carrying one of them
acceptanceCriteria.when: the mapper writes the wire response
acceptanceCriteria.then: the retry hint reflects the elicited per-class contract for that category (applied alongside the ADR-1702 defaults)
